description: Create journal entries for Lightyear dividend, interest, and reward distributions, including withheld tax. DRY RUN by default. With fx_source="ecb", a foreign distribution that stays in its currency (no conversion on the statement) is valued at the ECB reference rate of its statement day; the rate (or the failed lookup) is bound into the reviewed plan and execute never refetches. Retained USD distributions are logged in the USD cash-fund pool.

fee_account.description: Platform fee expense account (default 8610 Muud finantskulud)

file_path.description: AccountStatement path/base64 input. Provide exactly one of file_path or file_ref.

fund_distribution_account.description: Account for fund Distribution rows — both Lightyear cash funds (BRICEKSP, ICSUSSDP) alike (default: auto-detect 'Tulu fondiosakute ümberhindlusest', standard 8320).

fx_source.description: Rate source for foreign distributions: "statement" (default) needs the paired Lightyear conversion; "ecb" values a distribution that has no conversion at all at the ECB rate of its statement day (weekend/holiday: last earlier published rate). Today's rate is never final.

income_account.description: Income account for Dividend rows (dividends from directly-held shares → 8330 'Tulu aktsiatelt ja osadelt'). Fund Distribution rows use fund_distribution_account and Interest rows use interest_account.

interest_account.description: Account for Interest rows (default: auto-detect 'Intressitulu hoiustelt', standard 8400).

lightyear_account.description: Lightyear account id (e.g. CHZELUU) for the USD pool when the statement's file name does not carry it.

plan_handle.description: Execution-plan handle from the reviewed dry run. Required for dry_run=false.

reward_account.description: Account for platform rewards/bonuses (default: auto-detect 'Muud finantstulud', standard 8600). Rewards are broker fee/campaign income, not securities income.

tax_account.description: Withheld tax receivable/expense account (for tax_amount from CSV)

name: book_lightyear_distributions
title: Book Lightyear Distributions
